The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions. The perspective distortion is likely not an artifact, so I would reduce its severity to 0.5 or mark it as negligible. I would add a new artifact observation for 'structural_uncertainty' in the hind limbs and face regions, with severity 2.0.
